import sys,json,time,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/claude-501/-Volumes-SSD990-crypto-autoresearcher/655992ba-4699-434f-a2ad-3a4774fe7a8d/scratchpad/rt' if False else '.')
from rtlib import *

DOM="REDTEAM-J2-c819ba/v1"

def is_p(n):
    if n<2: return False
    d=2
    while d*d<=n:
        if n%d==0: return False
        d+=1
    return True

def trace(N,p): return p+1-N

def build(A,B,p):
    if (4*pow(A,3,p)+27*pow(B,2,p))%p==0: return None
    pts,fb=enumerate_and_fb(A,B,p)
    N=len(pts)+1
    if trace(N,p)%p==0: return None   # supersingular -> excluded (ordinary only)
    try:
        n1,n2,G1,G2=group_structure(pts,A,p)
        pc=coord_map(N,A,p,n1,n2,G1,G2)
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    return dict(p=p,A=A,B=B,N=N,n1=n1,n2=n2,pts=pts,fb=fb,pc=pc,t=trace(N,p))

def cell(cv,denom,seed,ndraw=30,ms=(2,3,4)):
    N=cv['N']; F=ladder_F(N,denom)
    if F<4 or F>len(cv['fb']): return None
    real=stats([cv['pc'][q] for q in cv['fb'][:F]],cv['n1'],cv['n2'],N,F,ms)
    dom=f"{DOM}/run-{seed}"
    nulls=[]
    for i in range(ndraw):
        s=draw_symmetric_null(cv['pts'],cv['p'],F,dom,0,i)
        nulls.append(stats([cv['pc'][q] for q in s],cv['n1'],cv['n2'],N,F,ms))
    out={'F':F,'C_over_F_real':real['C_over_F']}
    for m in ms:
        rest=[n[m]['var'] for n in nulls[1:]]           # executor convention
        mu=sum(rest)/len(rest)
        allv=[n[m]['var'] for n in nulls]
        mua=sum(allv)/len(allv); sda=(sum((v-mua)**2 for v in allv)/len(allv))**.5
        out[f'L2_m{m}']=real[m]['var']/mu
        out[f'z_m{m}']=(real[m]['var']-mua)/sda if sda else None
        out[f'nvn_m{m}']=nulls[0][m]['var']/mu
        out[f'rank_m{m}']=sum(1 for v in allv if v<real[m]['var'])
    cs=[n['C_over_F'] for n in nulls]
    muC=sum(cs)/len(cs); sdC=(sum((v-muC)**2 for v in cs)/len(cs))**.5
    out['L3']=real['C_over_F']/muC
    out['z_L3']=(real['C_over_F']-muC)/sdC if sdC else None
    out['rank_L3']=sum(1 for v in cs if v<real['C_over_F'])
    return out

def lab(r,lo,hi): return 'IN' if lo<=r<=hi else ('ABOVE' if r>hi else 'BELOW')

if __name__=='__main__':
    mode=sys.argv[1]
    seeds=[int(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split(',')]
    pmin,pmax=int(sys.argv[3]),int(sys.argv[4])
    denoms=[int(x) for x in sys.argv[5].split(',')]
    PANEL_EXCLUDE={127,157,307,1013,421}
    primes=[q for q in range(pmin,pmax+1) if is_p(q) and q not in PANEL_EXCLUDE]
    rows=[]
    t0=time.time()
    for p in primes:
        cands=[]
        if mode in ('j0','both'):
            # j=0 needs p=1 mod 3; take up to 3 distinct twist classes by smallest B
            if p%3==1:
                seenN=set()
                for B in range(1,p):
                    cv=build(0,B,p)
                    if cv and cv['N'] not in seenN:
                        seenN.add(cv['N']); cands.append(('J0',cv))
                    if len(cands)>=2: break
        if mode in ('ro','both'):
            # matched random-ordinary: deterministic hash rule INDEPENDENT of executor's
            for t in range(500):
                h=hashlib.sha256(f"RT|ro|{p}|{t}".encode()).digest()
                A=int.from_bytes(h[:16],'big')%p; B=int.from_bytes(h[16:],'big')%p
                if A==0 or B==0: continue
                cv=build(A,B,p)
                if cv: cands.append(('RO',cv)); break
        if mode=='j1728':
            if p%4==1:
                seenN=set()
                for A in range(1,p):
                    cv=build(A,0,p)
                    if cv and cv['N'] not in seenN:
                        seenN.add(cv['N']); cands.append(('J1728',cv))
                    if len(cands)>=2: break
        for role,cv in cands:
            for denom in denoms:
                for sd in seeds:
                    c=cell(cv,denom,sd)
                    if c is None: continue
                    c.update(role=role,p=p,A=cv['A'],B=cv['B'],N=cv['N'],n1=cv['n1'],n2=cv['n2'],
                             t=cv['t'],denom=denom,seed=sd)
                    rows.append(c)
        print(f"  ...p={p} done  t={time.time()-t0:.0f}s  rows={len(rows)}",file=sys.stderr)
    json.dump(rows,open(sys.argv[6],'w'))
    print("wrote",sys.argv[6],len(rows),"rows",time.time()-t0)

import sys,json,time,random
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from rtlib import *
PANEL=[('RO1',127,3,102),('RO2',157,43,144),('RO3',307,269,6),('RO4',1013,594,534),
       ('J0',307,0,6),('J1728',1013,594,0),('CM1',127,50,83),('CM2',127,68,30)]
NDRAW=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 200
cache={}
t0=time.time()
for role,p,A,B in PANEL:
    pts,fb=enumerate_and_fb(A,B,p); N=len(pts)+1
    n1,n2,G1,G2=group_structure(pts,A,p); pc=coord_map(N,A,p,n1,n2,G1,G2)
    for denom in (16,8,4,2):
        F=ladder_F(N,denom)
        real=stats([pc[q] for q in fb[:F]],n1,n2,N,F)
        ds=[]
        for i in range(NDRAW):
            s=draw_symmetric_null(pts,p,F,"REDTEAM-MC/c819ba",0,i)
            st=stats([pc[q] for q in s],n1,n2,N,F)
            ds.append({'v2':st[2]['var'],'v3':st[3]['var'],'v4':st[4]['var'],'cf':st['C_over_F']})
        cache[f"{role}|N/{denom}"]={'F':F,'N':N,
            'real':{'v2':real[2]['var'],'v3':real[3]['var'],'v4':real[4]['var'],'cf':real['C_over_F']},
            'draws':ds}
        print(f"  {role} N/{denom} F={F} done {time.time()-t0:.0f}s",file=sys.stderr)
json.dump(cache,open('mc_cache.json','w'))
print("cached",len(cache),"cells x",NDRAW,"draws in",time.time()-t0,"s")
